description: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering

title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws

title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm

title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
description: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang.
